findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: One of the soda nozzles and the coffee makers were observed soiled. The PIC was made aware. The PIC removed, cleaned and sanitized them respectively immediately. Ensure that food contact surfaces are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a hole in the wall near the licenses behind the black curtain. Ensure repairs are made to make this surface smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 Inspection Report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice for this violation. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: There is an unused ice machine in the back storage area. This machine needs to be removed from the premises unless it is repaired in to working order. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 inspection report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice. 
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The ceiling in the walk-in cooler is observed to be in a state of disrepair. Ensure the ceiling is repaired in a manner that makes it smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: This location is observed to only have 1 CFM on staff. In order to cover all hours of operation where food handling takes place, the facility needs to have more staff become Certified Food Managers. A CFM must be the person in charge and on duty during all hours of operation when food prep/cooking is taking place.
2-102.12: The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: The hand sink in the supply room is observed to not have any soap available. Ensure this sink is supplied with a supply of hand soap to allow for hand washing to take place. 
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The walk-in cooler is observed to have a drip. The facility is utilizing a plastic container to contain the drip, but proper repairs need to be made to the unit to prevent the drip from taking place.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed an accumulation of debris in the storage area and an observed syrup spill on the floor. Ensure detailed cleaning takes place of these areas at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soils/debris.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The back room where the triple sink is located is visibly soiled in various areas including beneath the triple sink. Ensure this room and other hard to reach places in the facility receive greater attention to detail during the cleaning process at a frequency necessary to maintain an increased level of cleanliness.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: No hot water is available at the hand washing sink in the restroom or the hand washing sink right outside the restroom door in the customer area. Provide hot water of at least 100F at each of these hand washing sinks.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12  (Pf) Provide water of at least 100 deg F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Reference 5-202.12.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There was no thermometer in the True freezer with the frozen pizzas.  Put a thermometer in the freezer.  It must be in a place where it can be easily read.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.  There was a gap between the blue and white counters below the cappuccino machine and the edge of the counter in the same location was damaged.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Seal the gap and repair the damaged counter.
2.  The top of the grease trap under the 3-pan sink was rusty.  Sand and paint the top of the grease trap.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The floor drain to the 3-pan sink was stopped up.  Clean the drain.

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
There were no disposable towels for the handsink to the right of the 3-pan sink.  Put disposable towels at the sink.

750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment:
The dumpster was stored on gravel.  Put the dumpster a cleanable asphalt or concrete surface.  Note: the cardboard dumpster does not have to be on such a surface.

75-1140 Garbage and refuse containers shall be in good repair and stored on or above concrete or asphalt.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1.  The bottom inside of the drink counter is soiled and needs a new floor put in it that is smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
2.  There are damaged floor tiles just inside the door of the walk-in cooler.  (REPEAT VIOLATION).  Replace the damaged tiles.
3.  The floor of the walk-in cooler is soiled in places under the shelves.  Clean the floor.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The strip of molding about 4 feet off the floor on the wall of the walk-in cooler is damaged and moldy in the back corner.  Repair/replace the molding.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Floor cleaner and Goo Gone were stored on the shelf above the 3-pan sink.  They were set on the grease trap below the sink to CORRECT the violation.

750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
